summary: Completed external API and UI testing for AstroAI. Backend regression is 9/9 passing; homepage, auth, Kundli, chat, palm, compatibility, pricing, mobile navigation, and overflow checks passed. One dashboard persistence integration issue remains.

integration_issues.issue: After creating a Kundli, reloading the page and opening Dashboard shows the empty 'Your map awaits' state even though /api/dashboard and /api/kundli/latest contain the saved chart. App.js restores only /api/auth/me and never fetches dashboard/chart data on session restore.

action_items: On authenticated session restore, fetch /api/dashboard or /api/kundli/latest and hydrate the dashboard Kundli state.
critical_code_review_comments: The frontend does not consume the implemented dashboard persistence API, so saved chart state is lost from the UI after reload.
seed_data_creation: Used the provided astroai.test@example.com account and created TEST_/UI test Kundli and palm records; no new user account was created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: External URL tested. Auth, API protection, chart persistence API, chat, palm validation/upload, navigation, pricing, compatibility, and mobile overflow passed. Retest dashboard hydration after reload. ASTROLOGY CALCULATIONS ARE MOCK DEVELOPMENT CALCULATIONS; AI and palm results may use clearly marked fallback text when unavailable; payments are UI-only.
rca of the issue: Initial POST /api/kundli and /api/palm returned 500 because Motor added Mongo ObjectId values to inserted response dictionaries and FastAPI could not JSON-encode them. Fixed by removing _id before returning. Remaining dashboard issue is frontend state hydration: App.js only calls /api/auth/me on startup and does not request the persisted chart/dashboard payload.
